$comment: Single source of truth for the Button API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

href.html: renders an <a class="vin-btn"> instead of a <button>

a11y: Native <button> element, so Enter and Space work without JavaScript.
type="button" by default so it never submits a form by accident.
Visible focus ring in every style and mode.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Use primary for the main action on a screen, and the quieter variants for everything else.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Sizes come from the style's scale, and Customize → Density adjusts all of them together. Icon buttons need an aria-label.

examples.title: Icons, disabled, links
examples.description: Pass href and the React Button renders a link. A disabled link gets aria-disabled and leaves the tab order.
